title: The Range Ranger
functionCode:
def find_min_max(nums:list[int]) -> str | int:
    nums_len = len(nums)
    if nums_len == 0: return -1
    min_val = nums[0]
    max_val = nums[0]
    for i in range(nums_len):
        if min_val > nums[i]: min_val = nums[i]
        if max_val < nums[i]: max_val = nums[i]
    return f"The max is: {max_val} and the min is {min_val}"
description: I scan any list of numbers and find the highest and lowest values.

title: First/Last Same
functionCode:
def check_first_last_same(nums:list[int]) -> bool:
    nums_len = len(nums)
    if nums_len == 0: return False
    first_elem = nums[0]
    last_elem = nums[nums_len]
    return first_elem == last_elem
